mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partner_grade WHERE grade_code = #{gradeCode})

SELECT g.grade_code, g.name, cur.rebate_rate AS current_rate, nxt.rebate_rate AS next_rate, nxt.valid_from AS next_valid_from FROM partner_grade g LEFT JOIN rebate_policy cur ON cur.grade_code = g.grade_code AND cur.valid_from <= #{today} AND (cur.valid_to IS NULL OR cur.valid_to > #{today}) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n.rebate_rate, n.valid_from FROM rebate_policy n WHERE n.grade_code = g.grade_code AND n.valid_from > #{today} ORDER BY n.valid_from LIMIT 1 ) nxt ON true ORDER BY cur.rebate_rate NULLS LAST, g.grade_code
SELECT id, valid_from FROM rebate_policy WHERE grade_code = #{gradeCode} AND valid_to IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE rebate_policy SET valid_to = #{validTo} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rebate_policy (grade_code, rebate_rate, valid_from) VALUES (#{gradeCode}, #{rebateRate}, #{validFrom})
